objective: Provide one independent public-only architecture dissent for the native Quest direction, challenge unsupported assumptions, and recommend the smallest coherent First Deal that can still feel exceptional.
public_context: You are an invited, non-authoritative architecture committee member. Evaluate a native Unreal Engine 5.7.4 seated social card experience for Meta Quest 3/3S. The product must prioritize controller and hand interaction equivalence with safe live switching; support a visibly robotic AI dealer or a human event host; use a deliberate VR fallback when mixed reality, room data, anchors or passthrough are unavailable; use only original, commissioned, public-domain or otherwise documented cleared music and recordings; and keep host-selected personal music external to the product, never ingested, cached, streamed, recorded or represented as cleared. The intended audience is broadly ages 30-70, with an inviting social-table rhythm and only a light Foundational Black American spirit in hospitality, energy and environment—never caricature, imitation or a claim to represent everyone. Current official evidence says Meta XR SDK 205.0 targets UE 5.7.4; Meta supports controller/hand multimodal input through OpenXR but documents switching and feature limitations; Shared Scene is a UE 5.4 LAN sample without production authentication or proven persistence; the Meta Avatars SDK was never released for Unreal and Unreal support is not planned; Meta publishes Android values NDK 25.1.8937393, minimum API 32 and Store target API 34; ADB/logcat procedures exist; and Meta targets 72 FPS with Quest 3/3S draw-call and triangle guidance. No physical device, package, two-headset, store, rights or human acceptance is proven. Compare a standalone native app, a Horizon world, and a deliberate hybrid/companion strategy. Return one JSON object with keys recommended_surface, decisive_reasons, must_build_now, defer, reject, controller_hand_strategy, mr_vr_strategy, identity_fallback, host_event_strategy, accessibility_for_30_70, cultural_guardrails, music_rights_boundary, competitive_differentiators, highest_risks, falsification_tests, strongest_dissent, and confidence. Use only the supplied public facts and general reasoning; do not browse, use tools, request private context, write code, issue a verdict, or claim acceptance.
